title: Pepperomia Caperata Rosso - Mini Plug Plant 1x - Hardy House Plant
description:
Peperomia caperata ‘Rosso’ – Compact Tropical Houseplant
        

        Peperomia caperata ‘Rosso’ is a small, easy-care houseplant known for its striking foliage. It features deep green, textured leaves with a rich red underside and red stems, creating a bold contrast. Native to South America, this variety stays compact and is ideal for desks, shelves, or small indoor spaces.
       

          Plant type:
         
         Tropical perennial houseplant
        

          Size:
         
         Typically grows 6–10 inches tall
        

          Light:
         
         Prefers bright, indirect light
        

          Watering:
         
         Allow top inch of soil to dry between waterings
        

          Humidity:
         
         Enjoys moderate humidity but adapts to normal indoor conditions
        

          Pet safety:
         
         Generally considered non-toxic to pets
        

        Low maintenance and visually distinctive, ‘Rosso’ is a great choice for beginners or collectors looking for unique foliage.
